subject.title: fix(memory-core): skip unchanged Dreaming workspace state writes

question: Does the keyed plugin-state store treat `register()` metadata updates as a recency or retention signal that Dreaming workspace rows must refresh on unchanged runs?
rationale: The patch changes observable persistence-write behavior while preserving logical values; repository history establishes the SQLite-backed state path as owner-sensitive, but the available evidence does not prove the metadata/eviction contract.

options.title: Verify no-op retention semantics
options.body: Confirm from the keyed-store contract or add a focused regression test that unchanged Dreaming rows need no metadata refresh, then merge the optimization.

options.title: Preserve refresh semantics
options.body: If unchanged registrations intentionally maintain retention or eviction recency, retain that behavior and pursue a narrower batching or off-thread write solution instead.

recommendation.title: Verify no-op retention semantics
recommendation.body: Confirm from the keyed-store contract or add a focused regression test that unchanged Dreaming rows need no metadata refresh, then merge the optimization.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history ties the SQLite-backed Dreaming state path and recent Memory Core maintenance most directly to this reviewer.
